```{r}
#| eval: false
catGenes::run_catGenes()
```

### Description

This function runs the *catGenes* application. It will open
the application by using the default internet browser, or the viewer if running
from RStudio.

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| launch.browser | Run catGenes in browser |
| port | If launch.browser is FALSE, specify port to run catGenes |

### Examples

```r
if (interactive()) {
run_catGenes()
}
```
